source_policy: Generated PNG files copied unchanged. Regions, anchors, masks and deformation are authored in Godot; no raster retouching.

assets.prompt: Create a production 2D hand painted game sprite atlas, actual transparent background. Reference 1 is the ONLY identity, anatomy, proportions and costume reference: adult woman Sofia, dark brown hair, side cap, olive short military jacket to hips, leather harness, tan ammunition pouches, backpack/bedroll, loose dark trousers, sturdy flat lace-up boots. Reference 2 supplies chronological FOOTFALL POSES ONLY, not its body proportions. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, TWELVE complete full-body drawings forming one natural brisk walking cycle facing RIGHT, orthographic side view, consistent scale 7.5-head adult female anatomy. Same narrow shoulders, natural pelvis, long anatomically credible legs, SMALL realistic head; no caricature, no massive head, no exaggerated curves. Each cell same size; entire cap to boot fully visible, feet baseline at 92% of cell, pelvis horizontally centered. Delicate vertical weight transfer and alternating legs, near foot genuinely goes forward -> under pelvis -> back -> airborne recovery -> forward. Far leg follows opposite phase. Visible knees and boots, heel-to-toe contacts, one planted supporting foot except double contact, no skating or high knee marching. Whole body including head, torso and BOTH legs must be designed as ONE coherent drawing per frame. The torso leans subtly forward, hips and shoulders respond to support. IMPORTANT game assembly: omit BOTH ARMS entirely below shoulder sockets, do not draw any upper arm, sleeve, elbow or hand crossing the torso, just the torso clothing with closed shoulder socket ready to attach runtime arms; omit all weapons. This is a modular animation body layer, not an injured character. Keep jacket short and do NOT add long coat. No separate heads, no stray body parts, no text, guide marks, floor, shadows, cell borders or background. High quality restrained realistic painted materials, even neutral light, identical outfit and facial identity in all frames. 1536x1536 or larger square canvas preferred.

Create matching production 2D painted game animation atlas for this SAME adult woman Sofia, exactly same face, small head, body proportions, short olive jacket, pouches, backpack, loose trousers, flat boots and side cap. Twelve drawings in EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS THREE ROWS, consistent side view facing RIGHT, transparent alpha, no text or grid. This time a REAL NATURAL RUN CYCLE with clearly different successive poses, not walking. Preserve 7.5-head anatomy and unchanging thigh/shin lengths. Torso inclined forward about 10 degrees, stable head, natural weight bounce. Alternating support and AIRBORNE flight, heels lift behind, knees advance, boots genuinely leave the ground. Row-major poses: 1 near-foot forward contact far heel high behind; 2 near support compressed far knee recovers; 3 near leg drives back far knee passes forward; 4 near push-off far knee forward; 5 BOTH boots airborne near trailing far front; 6 far boot extends to contact near heel behind. 7 opposite contact FAR foot forward near heel high behind; 8 far support compressed near knee recovers; 9 far drives back near knee passes; 10 far push-off near knee forward; 11 BOTH airborne far trailing near front; 12 near extends to contact far heel behind. Keep the two halves distinct: darker far leg forward at pose7 versus lighter near leg forward at pose1. Omit both arms below shoulder sockets and ALL guns like reference modular body layer; torso/head/BOTH legs remain one coherent full-body drawing per cel. Same global pixel scale in all twelve cells, no individually enlarging short poses; generous gutters and entire head/feet visible, ground baseline around 92% of each cell, pelvis horizontally centered. No stretched limbs, chibi proportions, long coat, extra legs or disconnected body parts.

Matching production game full-body action atlas of EXACT same Sofia from reference, realistic handpainted adult female anatomy, small head 7.5-head proportions, short olive jacket, tan pouches, backpack, brown hair cap, dark trousers and sturdy flat boots. EXACT grid FOUR columns by THREE rows, twelve isolated full-body sprites, all side view facing RIGHT, same anatomical size and drawing scale. Leave generous padding in each cell, never cut off boot or hair. Arms deliberately omitted below shoulder sockets in every cell, no weapons, no loose body parts, no text, floor, guides or background; actual transparent alpha. Unlike locomotion reference these are distinct realistic ACTION POSES, read row-major: 1 natural standing relaxed knees almost straight boots under hips; 2 crouch with hips lowered and knees naturally bent, torso slightly forward; 3 crouch walking near foot ahead; 4 crouch walking far foot ahead. Row2: 5 jump takeoff compress both knees, 6 ascending jump knees flexed slightly, 7 falling legs lowered ready for landing, 8 landing absorb impact deep knees torso forward. Row3: 9 forward dash athletic low forward lunge trailing leg extended; 10 controlled feet-first ground slide with torso leaning back 35 degrees and one leg extended forward, hip low; 11 ladder climbing side view one knee lifted toward rung and one leg down; 12 pushing heavy crate posture with torso leaning forward 20 degrees, staggered planted boots and loaded bent knees. IMPORTANT Do not make crouched figures taller by enlarging them. Their heads are same actual pixel size as standing figure, total crouched height around 70% standing height, slide around 50%. Head/torso/BOTH legs one coherent cel with natural pelvis/knee construction; no independently repeated cutout limbs. Exact same woman, costume and light in all cells. Visible negative space between legs as appropriate.

Matching painted modular ARM sprite atlas for this Sofia military woman. Exactly FOUR columns TWO rows, EIGHT isolated complete right arms from rounded shoulder cap through elbow to gloved hand, olive cloth sleeves, subtle seams and blank shield patch at upper arm, brown fingerless leather gloves with small visible fingertips curling around an invisible firearm grip. Anatomically realistic SLENDER adult female arms, consistent shoulder/elbow/wrist sizes and BONE LENGTHS across all eight poses: shoulder to elbow length 150 pixels, elbow to wrist 140 pixels, wrist to fingertips 30 pixels approximately. Upper arms oriented DOWN in every cell, only elbow bends toward RIGHT, elbow bending anatomically: chronological 0 almost straight 15degree flexion, 1 flexion35degrees, 2 flexion60degrees, 3 flexion80degrees, 4 flexion100degrees, 5 flexion120degrees, 6 flexion140degrees, 7 flexion155degrees (hand by shoulder). Same paint style and outfit color as reference. Smooth natural muscle and cloth volume at elbow, no rigid pipes, no pinching or deflated elbow. Entire arm including hand in each cell, identical pixel scale, generous transparent gutters, avoid any overlap between neighboring cells. No body, heads, legs, weapons, grids, text or background. Actual transparent alpha. This is a 2D game cutout sheet; hand should be rotated naturally with forearm, closed around invisible narrow handle rather than flat open palm. Shoulder cap must be opaque cloth with no black hole.

Production 2D painted game sprite sheet of SAME Sofia from reference with identical realistic woman anatomy/costume/face/small head. Exactly FOUR columns THREE rows, twelve full-body cels, true transparent alpha no text/lines/ground. All face RIGHT side-on; consistent anatomical size and source pixel scale, short olive jacket, tan harness/pouches/backpack, cap/brown hair, loose dark trousers and flat boots. Omit BOTH ARMS completely below shoulder sockets as modular runtime arm layer. Each row is a coherent FOUR-frame cycle, chronological left to right: ROW1 CROUCH WALK: 1 near boot forward far back pelvis low, 2 near supports and far knee passes with boot lifted, 3 FAR boot forward near back pelvis low, 4 far supports near knee passes boot lifted. Maintain bent knees and same low head height, no standing up or changing head size. ROW2 LADDER CLIMB: torso nearly upright facing RIGHT, 1 near knee lifted at hip, far leg extended down, 2 near foot planted high lifting pelvis, far knee rising, 3 far knee lifted at hip and near leg extended down, 4 far foot planted high lifting pelvis while near knee rises. Boots point naturally at rungs (not drawn). ROW3 PUSH A HEAVY OBJECT: shoulders lean 25 degrees forward, pelvis back, 1 near foot planted forward far heel back, 2 near supports far foot shuffles forward OFF FLOOR, 3 far foot planted forward near heel back, 4 far supports near foot shuffles forward. Loaded bent knees, no exaggerated long strides. Head, torso, both legs and clothing one coherent drawing per cel; same bone lengths all frames, no independent pasted limbs. Fit every full sprite with at least 15px clear gutters inside each equal cell, no clipping or overlapping neighboring cells. Crouched figures remain about 70% height of standing figure at same scale; do not enlarge to fill cells. Restrained natural weight shift, no heroic posing, no giant head, no extra legs/arms.

Make a production supplemental 2D painted game atlas for the same Sofia woman in the reference. These are HIDDEN-SURFACE LEG LAYERS for ragdoll, to reveal the normally occluded leg behind the other leg. Exactly FOUR separate complete SINGLE legs in ONE horizontal row, generous gutters, full trouser leg from hip joint/upper thigh to complete boot tip. Realistic slim adult female anatomy, same dark loose trousers and rugged FLAT SOLED military lace-up boots as reference, no high heels. Proportions constant, same thigh/shin lengths across all four. Frame1 leg nearly straight pointing down, toe RIGHT; frame2 knee flexed 45 degrees with heel drawn back LEFT behind knee, toe pointing down/right naturally; frame3 knee flexed 90 degrees with shin angled back LEFT, hip still above knee; frame4 knee flexed 130 degrees with heel raised back toward hip. Draw all normally hidden cloth surfaces continuously, no holes at hip/knee/ankle, no part of another leg. Keep natural knee/ankle construction and intact boot volume. Side-view, neutral matching painted light, dark olive-gray fabric, brown leather, no upper body, pelvis, skirt, hands, gun, floor, text, guide or background. Actual transparent alpha. Each cell equal dimensions; keep generous margin so no sprite touches another. Leave the source files as a clean isolated layered atlas. These are complete limbs, not a full character.
